prop.name: View
prop.description: Pie Menu View.

prop.name: ID
prop.description: Pie Menu Unique ID.

prop.name: Name
prop.description: Pie Menu Name, shown if the HTML Content is empty.

prop.name: HTML Content
prop.description: HTML Element Content in Center of Pie Menu. If empty, the pie menu Name is shown instead.

prop.name: Clockwise
prop.description: Clockwise Layout Direction (false for CCW).

prop.name: Initial Angle
prop.description: Initial Angle for Pie Item Layout. 0 is right, 90 is up, 180 is left, 270 is down.

prop.name: Fixed Radius
prop.description: Fixed Radius for Pie Item Layout (0 to Disable). Overrides calculated radius.

prop.name: Minimum Radius
prop.description: Minimum Radius for Pie Item Layout. Overridden by non-zero Fixed Radius.

prop.name: Extra Radius
prop.description: Extra Radius for Pie Item Layout. Overridden by non-zero Fixed Radius.

prop.name: Inactive Radius
prop.description: Inactive Radius of Pie Menu Center, where no item is selected.

prop.name: Radius Notch
prop.description: Radius Notch for Pie Item Layout. Overridden by non-zero Fixed Radius.

prop.name: Border
prop.description: Border around Menu for Pie Item Layout.

prop.name: Max Pie Items
prop.description: Maximum Number of Pie Items. Extra items are treated as Linear.

prop.name: Paged Pie Items
prop.description: Number of Pie Items Paged. Previous items are treated as Linear.

prop.name: Linear
prop.description: Pie Menu Linear Flag. Default for all items.

prop.name: Linear Direction
prop.description: Direction of Linear Item Layout. Default for all items.

prop.name: Linear Order Reversed
prop.description: Reversed Linear Order Layout Flag. Default for all items.

prop.name: Transparent Items
prop.description: Make Unselected Items Transparent During Tracking.

prop.name: Item Border
prop.description: Border Around Items for Pie Item Layout. Default for all items.

prop.name: Item Margin
prop.description: Margin Inside Items for Pie Item Layout. Default for all items.

prop.name: Item Width
prop.description: Fixed Item Width for Pie Item Layout (0 for Measured). Default for all items.

prop.name: Item Height
prop.description: Fixed Item Height for Pie Item Layout (0 for Measured). Default for all items.

prop.name: Item Normal Background Color
prop.description: Item Normal Background Color. Default for all items.

prop.name: Item Selected Background Color
prop.description: Item Selected Background Color. Default for all items.

prop.name: Center Background Color
prop.description: Pie Menu Center Background Color.

prop.name: Center Margin
prop.description: Pie Menu Center Margin.

prop.name: Center Border Width
prop.description: Pie Menu Center Border Width.

prop.name: Center Visible
prop.description: Pie Menu Center Visibility Flag.

prop.name: URL
prop.description: URL for Pie Menu Selection. Default for all items.

prop.name: Action
prop.description: Action for Pie Menu Item Selection. Default for all items.

prop.name: On Select
prop.description: Handler for Pie Menu Item Selection (Called After Selection). Default for all items.

prop.name: On Change
prop.description: Handler for Pie Menu Item Change (Called Before Selection). Default for all items.

prop.name: On Preview
prop.description: Handler for Pie Menu Item Preview (Called After Mouse Movement). Default for all items.
